baseline_models.focus_anchor: The construction places a divine act over their ears while locating them inside the cave.
baseline_models.mechanism: The striking action withholds the ears' receptive function while the cave encloses them as refuge, producing protected sensory sequestration rather than an undirected lapse into sleep.

activation_trace.role: Withholding and turning away supplies the active interruption laid over hearing.
The bodily ear fixes the intervention at a concrete sensory threshold.
Listening and accepting what is heard extends the closure from sound to receptivity.
Refuge makes the cave a protective container for the sensory withdrawal.

changed_reading.before: They simply fall asleep in a cave.
changed_reading.after: A directed act suspends their acoustic and receptive relation to the outside while refuge holds them.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The paired expression 'years, numbered' qualifies the duration of the ear-closure.
baseline_models.mechanism: Annual time is joined to enumeration and a counted waiting term, so the suspension is administered as a bounded interval rather than left as vague long duration.

activation_trace.role: The year and its temporal span supply the duration units.
Enumeration makes the years countable rather than merely numerous.
A counted waiting period gives the interval the function of a term to be completed.

changed_reading.before: An indefinitely long span passes over the sleepers.
changed_reading.after: Their suspension begins as a delimited waiting term whose units are already under count.

context_deltas.mechanism: The youths ask for mercy and a prepared course after taking refuge; the ear-closure then occupies the causal middle before refuge is again linked with mercy and facility. The apparent incapacitation becomes the means by which withdrawal is made protective and serviceable.

activation_trace.role: Withholding supplies the focus action that interrupts exposure to the outside.
The focus cave is the refuge in which that interruption operates.
Joining a shelter establishes the youths' deliberate movement into protection.
Mercy supplies the requested purpose that the protective mechanism answers.
Preparation and repair frame the requested outcome as an arranged course.
Opening and spreading turns mercy into an enveloping effect within the cave.
Benefit and facility identify the practical result of the arranged refuge.

structural_cues: The sequence is request in 18:10, divine ear-action in 18:11, then repeated refuge, mercy, preparation, and facility in 18:16.
The cave is repeated at each stage rather than introduced only as scenery.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a request for merciful preparation and a later promise of merciful facility; I infer that the intervening ear-closure enables that answer. A live alternative is that the closure is only one sign within a broader, unpartitioned answer.

changed_reading.before: The ear-strike is a neutral or forceful induction of sleep.
changed_reading.after: The ear-strike enacts the requested mercy by making hostile-world withdrawal durable and useful.

context_deltas.mechanism: The action over ears is syntactically echoed by fastening over hearts, then extended by repeated bodily turning. External receptivity, inner resolve, and bodily position become coordinated sites of preservation.

activation_trace.role: Withholding supplies the intervention at the outer receptive boundary.
The ears are the first explicit bodily site under divine action.
Heart-fastening supplies a second divine stabilization at an inner bodily site.
The heart locates that stabilization in resolve and interior life.
Turning a thing from one face to another supplies continuing bodily management.

structural_cues: 18:11 and 18:14 repeat first-person plural divine action plus 'upon' plus a possessed body part.
18:18 continues first-person plural action directly upon their bodies.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the ears/hearts syntactic echo and later body-turning; I join them as one preservation program. They could instead be separate interventions serving sleep, courage, and physical maintenance independently.

changed_reading.before: Only hearing is disabled for sleep.
changed_reading.after: The ears are one control point in whole-person custody: intake is suspended, resolve is fastened, and bodies are maintained.

context_deltas.mechanism: The ear boundary blocks auditory intake while the cave system routes sunlight past the sleepers, leaves them in an interior opening, turns their bodies, and marks the threshold. The refuge works as a selectively regulated habitat rather than a sealed dark box.

activation_trace.role: Withholding supplies closure at the auditory threshold.
The mountain cave supplies the enclosing physical environment.
Inclining away supplies the diversion of direct sunlight from the cave.
Passing across a place to its side supplies the sun's routed transit.
The widened space between sides supplies a ventilated interior position.
Alternating their orientation supplies active bodily regulation.
The connected house entrance or threshold locates a guarded perimeter.

structural_cues: 18:17 coordinates the sun's two trajectories with the sleepers' position inside the cave.
18:18 adds repeated turning and places the dog at the threshold.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies several controlled positions and motions; I infer a single microenvironmental mechanism whose auditory gate begins in 18:11. A live alternative is that the later details are independent signs or descriptions, not one designed system.

changed_reading.before: The cave is a passive dark container and the ear-strike is merely a sleep switch.
changed_reading.after: The ear-strike begins a selective-permeability refuge in which sound, light, posture, space, and access are differently managed.

context_deltas.mechanism: The numbered years are objective and bounded from the divine side, but ear-closure severs experienced time from counted time. Awakening converts the completed term into an experiment in estimation: the sleepers compress it, parties compete to enumerate it, and final knowledge remains asymmetrical.

activation_trace.role: Annual time supplies the objective units traversed during suspension.
A counted waiting term makes the interval bounded before anyone later estimates it.
Exhaustive enumeration turns awakening into a contest over temporal accounting.
Remaining in one place identifies what the parties must measure.
A terminal limit makes the measured stay an interval with an endpoint.
Repeated reference to their stay carries the duration into their failed self-estimate.
Enumeration reappears as disputed counting of the sleepers themselves.
Disclosure to the knower reserves full temporal knowledge to God.

structural_cues: 18:12 explicitly states the waking purpose through which party best enumerates the stay's limit.
18:19 compresses the sleepers' self-estimate to a day or part of one.
18:22 relocates counting into disputed headcounts; 18:25 states years, and 18:26 closes by reserving knowledge of the stay to God.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a bounded count, an enumeration test, a radically compressed self-estimate, and reserved knowledge; I infer that sensory suspension causes experiential discontinuity and thus makes duration an epistemic test. It could instead be a narrative measurement problem unrelated to the specific ear mechanism.

changed_reading.before: Numbered years only report how long the sleep lasts.
changed_reading.after: The count is also an epistemic timer: objectively completed, subjectively inaccessible, and exposed only after awakening.

context_deltas.mechanism: Their hearing is closed, an observer's sight misclassifies waking and sleep, the hidden sleepers are later exposed, and divine seeing and hearing remain maximal. Information is not absent; access to it is selectively withheld and then released.

activation_trace.role: Listening and accepting what is heard supply the human information channel put out of operation.
Conjecture supplies the observer's visually induced but incorrect classification.
Wakefulness supplies the apparent state.
Sleep and stillness supply the concealed actual state.
Coming upon what was hidden supplies the later controlled disclosure.
Divine sight remains unobstructed where human visual inference fails.
Divine hearing remains unobstructed in direct contrast with the sealed human ears.

structural_cues: 18:18 explicitly opposes apparent wakefulness to actual sleep.
18:21 gives the disclosure a knowledge-producing purpose.
18:26 pairs emphatic seeing and hearing after affirming superior knowledge of their stay.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies blocked human hearing, misleading visible appearance, eventual exposure, and unrestricted divine perception; I infer a governed disclosure system. A live alternative is a simpler contrast between creaturely limitation and divine omniscience without a staged information mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The closed ears merely indicate unconsciousness.
changed_reading.after: The closed ears mark asymmetric access: human sensing and reckoning are gated while divine perception governs when the hidden sign becomes knowable.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the place-and-craft branch of the striking root and links it to later building over the sleepers. It remains anchored in the focus verb, 'upon their ears,' and the physical cave; downstream prose should present it only as an architectural analogy, not as a replacement lexical translation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The action is laid over the ears inside a mountain chamber.

activation_trace.role: The place, craft, and tent-pitching scope permits an image of constructing a cover over the ears.
The bodily ears give that imagined inner cover a precise target.
The mountain chamber supplies the outer architectural enclosure.
Joining parts into a building later over them mirrors enclosure at a larger scale.

changed_reading.before: A blow causes sleep inside an already existing shelter.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the act erects an acoustic shelter over the ears inside the cave, later mirrored by people proposing a structure over the sleepers.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the womb branch behind a surface occurrence of mercy and maps the cave term onto gestation. It remains anchored by the focus refuge and counted years followed by stirring and revivification branches; downstream prose should mark it as a birth-like re-emergence analogy, not a claim that the cave is literally a womb or that mercy changes lexical sense.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: A refuge encloses them for a completed counted term before they are stirred.

activation_trace.role: Refuge supplies the enclosing protected space.
Years supply the long developmental interval.
A completed waiting term gives the enclosure a gestational temporal shape.
The womb branch supplies the contained generative analogy while the source occurrence remains mercy.
Stirring the still from repose supplies emergence from the enclosed term.
Revivification after death intensifies the birth-like return into a changed world.

changed_reading.before: They undergo a long sleep in a hiding place.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, they pass through a gestational interval in a womb-like refuge and re-emerge into a new historical world.

strongest_changes: The ear-strike becomes the practical answer to a request for merciful, prepared refuge.
The ears join hearts and bodies as coordinated sites of divine stabilization.
The numbered years become an epistemic timer separating objective duration from experienced and disputed duration.
Blocked human hearing participates in controlled concealment and disclosure under unrestricted divine perception.
summary.what_was_special: The context turns one compact action into the first control point of a layered refuge: sensory, affective, bodily, spatial, temporal, and epistemic mechanisms remain distinct but can coexist.
remaining_uncertainties: The ear intervention may primarily denote physiological sleep, broader withdrawal from receptive engagement, or both.
The bodily and spatial details may form one coordinated preservation system or several juxtaposed signs.
The architectural and gestational outliers are branch-grounded analogies, not lexical claims.
